system.description: Choose one target when you make this Promise. Your actions are a personal mission to enact vengeance against that creature for a wrong. Work with your GM to outline that wrong. When you achieve your mission of vengeance against that target, lose all Witch powers until you Atone and seek a new target of vengeance (or take a new Promise). Additionally, lose your Witch powers if you do not take any action towards fulfilling your Vengeance between any two consecutive long rests.
